title: Bingo and having no hobbies besides music
summary: He plays bingo and says music is his only real interest.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Well, on the days you're not working and the nights you're not playing at Preservation Hall, what do you do?
I won $40 one night. I won $40 one night. At Lady Conway on Luzin Avenue. I came back the next week for $130. I'm going to hit a bingo game.
Yeah, you do better on the bingo than you do on the horses, huh?
You don't play race on the bingo? No, that's good. The only people who make money on the horses are the jockey. Do you have any hobbies or any other interests besides your music? That's what I like.
Music must seem at work. That's all I like.
